translations.title: Vitamin E 400 IU Soft Capsule
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to relieve vitamin E deficiency, poor peripheral circulation, stiff shoulders and neck around menopause, numbness and coldness in the hands and feet, intermittent claudication, and frostbite.
translations.usage: Adults take 50–1,000 IU of vitamin E a day.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you are hypersensitive to it, are allergic to soybean oil, soy or peanuts, or are breastfeeding, and avoid high doses during pregnancy. Talk to a pharmacist if you have a tendency to form blood clots, or if you are taking oral anticoagulants, vitamin A, vitamin K or iron supplements.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Vitamin E deficiency; poor peripheral circulation; numbness and coldness in the hands and feet
summaryTable.Who should be careful: People with a clotting tendency, or taking anticoagulants or birth-control pills

summary: Vitamin E deficiency and poor peripheral circulation
